answer: Sybil resistance works as a bonded-attestation gate: each agent locks capital that a grader quorum can slash when its epoch answer fails peer checks. Spawning harbor sockpuppet keys still needs a separate lagoon-sized bond per identity, and flooding with low-effort dawn copy text triggers slashing that burns those bonds before any diluted mining share can repay them. Attacker cost therefore scales linearly with fake count while honest yield does not.
